title: Lemon and Garlic Butter Linguine
changes_from_base: A glossy lemon, garlic and butter sauce emulsified with pasta water replaces the tomato sauce.
summary: Linguine in a glossy lemon, garlic and butter sauce brought together with starchy pasta water, ready in 20 minutes.

ingredients.item: fine salt for 3 litres of pasta water (0.8%)
ingredients.note: about 4 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the linguine in 3 litres salted water until al dente. Save about 500 ml of the water and drain.

steps.title: Garlic butter
steps.text: Dry the pot, set it over low heat and add the butter. As it melts, grate the garlic straight in and stir 1-2 min until fragrant. Grate in the lemon zest and add the pepper.

steps.title: Emulsify
steps.text: When the pepper sizzles, add the pasta and about 240 ml of the water. Raise the heat to medium-high and toss hard. Keep adding a few spoonfuls of water as it bubbles away and toss for 1-2 min, until the butter and starch have formed a thick, glossy coating.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Off the heat, squeeze in the lemon juice and toss again. Adding the acid last keeps it bright and stops the sauce splitting. Serve with Parmesan and parsley.

tips: Keep tossing vigorously while adding the water; that is what makes the sauce emulsify.
Add the juice off the heat to keep it fresh.
Chilli flakes make a good extra finish.
storage: Cool and refrigerate in an airtight container within 2 hours for up to 2 days. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot (74 °C).
